UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile within the PixelPass AI application, storing basic identification details and preferences.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The user's email address, primarily used for identification within the application (not for authentication).

lastSelectedBgColor.description: The hex code of the last background color selected by the user in the editor.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

CountryPassportRequirement.title: CountryPassportRequirement
CountryPassportRequirement.description: Defines the official passport photo requirements for a specific country, enabling auto-detection features.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CountryPassportRequirement entity.

countryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US' for United States).

countryName.description: The full name of the country (e.g., 'United States', 'United Kingdom').

photoWidthCm.description: The standard required width of the passport photo in centimeters.

photoHeightCm.description: The standard required height of the passport photo in centimeters.

headSizeMinCm.description: The minimum required head size (e.g., from chin to crown) in centimeters.

headSizeMaxCm.description: The maximum required head size (e.g., from chin to crown) in centimeters.

eyeLineMinCm.description: The minimum required distance from the bottom of the photo to the eye line in centimeters.

eyeLineMaxCm.description: The maximum required distance from the bottom of the photo to the eye line in centimeters.

backgroundRequirements.description: A description of the specific background requirements (e.g., 'pure white, no shadows, uniform lighting').

expressionRequirements.description: A description of the required facial expression (e.g., 'neutral, eyes open, mouth closed').

notes.description: Any additional specific rules or guidelines for the country's passport photo, such as accessory restrictions.

lastUpdatedBySource.description: A timestamp or string indicating when these requirements were last verified or updated from an official source.

CustomPassportSize.title: CustomPassportSize
CustomPassportSize.description: Allows users to define, save, and manage their own custom passport photo sizes with associated descriptions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CustomPassportSize entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created or owns this custom size. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N CustomPassportSize)

name.description: A user-friendly name given to this custom size (e.g., 'My 3x4 ID Photo', 'Visa Application Size').

description.description: A detailed explanation or purpose of this specific custom passport photo size.

widthCm.description: The custom width of the passport photo in centimeters.

heightCm.description: The custom height of the passport photo in centimeters.

order.description: The sort order index for display purposes.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when this custom size definition was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when this custom size definition was last updated.

ProcessedImage.title: ProcessedImage
ProcessedImage.description: Represents an image that has been processed by PixelPass AI, tracking its original state, processing status, and final output.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProcessedImage entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who uploaded the original image and initiated processing. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ProcessedImage)

originalImageUrl.description: The URL or path to the original image uploaded by the user.

processedImageUrl.description: The URL or path to the final, processed passport-style image.

status.description: The current status of the image processing job (e.g., 'pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed').

outputWidthCm.description: The final width of the processed image in centimeters, based on selected requirements.

outputHeightCm.description: The final height of the processed image in centimeters, based on selected requirements.

countryRequirementId.description: Optional reference to a CountryPassportRequirement if a standard country format was applied. (Relationship: CountryPassportRequirement 1:N ProcessedImage)

customPassportSizeId.description: Optional reference to a CustomPassportSize if a custom size was applied. (Relationship: CustomPassportSize 1:N ProcessedImage)

complianceScore.description: An AI-generated score indicating how compliant the processed image is with passport standards (0-100).

processingDetails.description: A field to store additional, potentially technical, details about the image processing steps or results, in a serialized format (e.g., JSON string).

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the image processing request was initiated.

completedAt.description: The timestamp when the image processing was completed (or marked as failed).

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure prioritizes Authorization Independence and Structural Segregation to ensure robust, debuggable security rules and efficient query performance.User-specific, private data (`UserProfile`, `CustomPassportSize`, `ProcessedImage`) is organized under `/users/{userId}` paths. This leverages Firestore's hierarchical nature to automatically scope data ownership to the authenticated user (`request.auth.uid`).The `CustomPassportSize` and `ProcessedImage` entities, which are logically owned by a `UserProfile`, are stored as subcollections of their respective user's profile: `/users/{userId}/custom_passport_sizes/{customPassportSizeId}` and `/users/{userId}/processed_images/{processedImageId}`. This adheres to **Access Modeling Principle C2 & C3**.Authorization Independence (Principle A) is achieved by mandating that every document in these subcollections (`CustomPassportSize` and `ProcessedImage`) includes a `userId` field. This `userId` field within the document *must* match the `{userId}` wildcard in its path and, consequently, `request.auth.uid`. This denormalization means that Firestore security rules can determine ownership and grant access by simply comparing `request.auth.uid` with the `{userId}` in the path and `resource.data.userId` without needing to perform `get()` operations on parent documents. This allows for atomic write operations and simplifies rule logic.For example, a rule for `custom_passport_sizes` would be:
`match /users/{userId}/custom_passport_sizes/{customPassportSizeId} { allow read, write: if request.auth.uid == userId && request.resource.data.userId == userId; }`The `CountryPassportRequirement` entity, representing global, read-only (for users) configuration data, is placed in a top-level collection: `/country_passport_requirements/{countryCode}`. This adheres to **Structural Segregation Principle B** by separating globally accessible data from user-private data. This collection's security posture is homogeneous (read-only for all authenticated users, admin-only for writes), making rules straightforward.Query Against Public Data (QAPs) is fully supported. For user-owned data, `list` operations implicitly filter by `userId` because a user can only query their own `/users/{uid}/...` path.
